name: ResizablePanel
description: Scrollable content panel that can be resized alone with native CSS resize or composed inside Splitter.
events: cu-resize {width,height} when ResizeObserver detects dimension change after initialization

accessibility.role: Optional named region when label/aria-label is supplied
accessibility.mode: Standalone CSS resize; disables CSS resize when used as a slotted pane in Splitter
accessibility.responsive: Constrained minimum sizes and theme surface
